SELECT coalesce((SELECT CASE WHEN sel.live THEN 'LIVE · ' || 'Run ' || lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM trade.process_run n WHERE (n.started_ms, n.run_id) <= (sel.started_ms, sel.run_id))::text, 2, '0') || ' · real orders on Bitget'

panels.title: Health
panels.description:
The Run's newest sample (its last second; a stopped Run's last), whatever the Range.

- **Status**: Running and for how long (green) · Starting: a new run, no sample yet · Stale (red): no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded — the process crashed or hung · Stopped (grey): stopped in order, and when · No Run.
- **Phase**: Off-Hours: entries allowed · US Regular: exits only · Close Window (amber): flattening before the close.
- **Anchor**: NAV: both legs on the issuer's NAV · Bell (grey): F × Binance's index at the close, provisional until the NAV is confirmed · Missing (amber): no anchor, no entries.
- **Session Close**: The regular close that ends the session (UTC+8) and the time left: everything is flat by then.
- **Attention**: None, or the first thing a person must look at: Position Mismatch, Stale Data, Records Not Written, Account Settings, Errors in the last hour (red); Stop Pending, Order Unknown, Warnings in the last hour (amber) · details in Diagnostics · System.

panels.title: Position · ct and USDT
panels.description:
- **Side**: Flat, or the open round trip's side: Long (both legs bought, blue), Short (both sold, orange).
- **${bull}**: Contracts held on the leg as the program counts them, signed (+ long, − short); – when flat.
- **Cost**: USDT: what the held contracts cost at entry, both legs (the notional held).
- **Held**: Time since the round trip opened.
- **To Exit**: σ still to go to the exit line (a Long: Sell Both up to −d_out σ; a Short: Buy Both down to +d_out σ); 0 or less: at the line, the exit is being sent · –: a leg's depth is unusable (the program sends no exit then; a book conflict does not stop an exit).

panels.title: Net
panels.description: USDT, realised: the net of the Run's round trips closed in the Range (P&L names it): Gross + Fees + Funding, round trips whose funding is not known yet left out until it is · the line: its running sum, a step at each close.

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel), k AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.closed_ms, c.net FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.closed_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND c.closed_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) AND c.funding_known AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill')
SELECT to_timestamp(t.ts / 1000.0) AS time, sum(t.net) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Net"
FROM (SELECT rg.from_ms AS ts, 0 AS net FROM rg
      UNION ALL SELECT k.closed_ms, k.net FROM k
      UNION ALL SELECT least(rg.to_ms - 1, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint), 0 FROM rg) t

panels.title: P&L · ${span} · USDT
panels.description:
The Run's round trips closed in the Range (title) · Net = Gross + Fees + Funding (left).

- **Open P&L**: Unrealised: the open round trip at the newest second's mids against its entry cost, after the entry fees of what is held, before exit fees and the half spread an exit pays (the band's distance to the mid); – when flat; not in Net.
- **Fees**: Trading fees of the closed round trips, as a cost (negative).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to them; + received.
- **Trips**: Round trips closed in the Range (those with funding still awaited included; no-fill ones left out).
- **Won**: Closed round trips with a positive net.

panels.title: Spread · D and σ · Last Second
panels.description:
- **Spread**: D, on both legs' mids: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2); 1 D = 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional.
- **Mean**: D: the program's mean of the spread (the Run's mean model).
- **σ**: D: its standard deviation (the Run's σ window).
- **Deviation**: (Spread − Mean) ÷ σ, on the mids; the executable sides are in Entry below.
- **F**: USD per USDT the program converts the anchors with.
- **As Of**: The second these figures are of (UTC+8).

panels.title: Entry · σ and D
panels.description:
- **Entry**: Can it open now: Ready (green, no signal yet) · Order Sent (green) · Blocked: the strategy's ordinary answer · Held Back (amber): waiting on the book, F, the venue or a stop · Needs a Person (red).
- **Why**: The reason in words (the program's idle reason this second), and after it a leg whose book keeps an entry from going out when that is not the reason itself (Regular Hours · SOXS Book Conflict).
- **Buy Both**: Now: the deviation buying both legs at their pricing levels, in σ (the band's top on the chart): a Long enters at −d_in σ · shown even while a book is not OK, for diagnosis.
- **Sell Both**: Selling both, in σ (the band's bottom): a Short enters at +d_in σ.
- **To Long Entry**: How far Buy Both still has to fall to the Long entry line (−d_in σ), in σ and in D; At the Line once there · —: a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable, so the program enters on none (Why names the leg).
- **To Short Entry**: How far Sell Both still has to rise to the Short entry line (+d_in σ) · — as for To Long Entry.

panels.title: Deviation from the Mean · σ
panels.description:
Deviation = (Spread − Mean) ÷ σ · Executable Band: Buy Both (buying both legs at their pricing levels, top) to Sell Both (selling both, bottom), in σ · a Long enters when the whole band is under the blue dashed line (Buy Both ≤ −d_in σ) and exits when it is over the blue dotted one (Sell Both ≥ −d_out σ); a Short enters over the orange dashed line (Sell Both ≥ +d_in σ) and exits under the orange dotted one (Buy Both ≤ +d_out σ) · each sample on the lines of the run that wrote it

Dots at each decision: Long Entry (blue, large), Short Entry (orange, large), the exit in the round trip's colour (smaller, not in the legend), Forced Exit (red), Other (grey: a trim, a completion, or a void entry that filled one leg or none) · shaded: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, net) · purple marks under the chart: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after in USD and USDT (owner item 62) · hover a dot: the action, both legs' contracts and average prices, notional, fees and the round trip's net · points: every second up to 25 min, then 5, 10, 30 s and whole minutes (a band edge is its bucket's extreme, of the seconds whose books the program enters on: none, and tooltip Book Not OK, where a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable) · a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run · the axis stops at ±8 σ: a spike beyond it is drawn to the edge, the tooltip gives its value.

       to_timestamp(r.stopped_ms / 1000.0) AS "Stopped", initcap(CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 60000 AND s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live) THEN 'running' WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'starting' ELSE 'lost' END) AS "State", CASE WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END AS "Ran",

       r.host AS "Host", r.run_id AS "Run ID", r.started_ms::text AS from_ms, coalesce(r.stopped_ms::text, 'now') AS to_ms
FROM trade.process_run r

  SELECT 'Newest Live Run · ' || 'Run ' || lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM trade.process_run n WHERE (n.started_ms, n.run_id) <= (r.started_ms, r.run_id))::text, 2, '0') AS __text, '__live' AS __value, 2 AS g, 0::bigint AS o

list.description: The round trip whose orders are shown: the Range's newest (the default); a click on Opened in Round Trips picks one.

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || initcap(c.direction) || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') AS __text, c.cycle_id AS __value

list.name: Long Round Trips
list.rawQuery:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT c.opened_ms AS time, coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS time_end,
       initcap(c.direction) || ' ' || to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS') || ' – ' || coalesce(to_char(to_timestamp((c.closed_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'open') || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') || ' · Net '
       || CASE WHEN c.status = 'open' THEN 'open' WHEN NOT c.funding_known THEN 'Pending' ELSE to_char(c.net, 'FM999,990.00') || ' USDT' END AS text
FROM trade.cycle c
WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.direction = 'long' AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill' AND c.opened_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1)
  AND coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg))

list.name: Anchor Changes
list.rawQuery:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'), rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel) SELECT x.ts_ms AS time, 'Anchor change · ' || CASE WHEN x.anchor_kind IS NULL THEN 'no anchor (Missing): no entries until one is read' WHEN x.ps IS DISTINCT FROM x.session_id THEN 'new session ' || x.session_id || ' (the close)
bell anchor (F × Binance''s index at the close; the NAV to follow)' WHEN x.pk IS NULL THEN 'an anchor read again' WHEN x.pk = 'bell' AND x.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV confirmed for session ' || x.session_id || '
both legs'' NAV unchanged for 1 h (Direxion' || coalesce(': first seen ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((min(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav_seen' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ', confirmed ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((max(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms), '') || ')' WHEN x.pk = 'nav' AND x.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'the bell again: the NAV no longer confirmed' WHEN (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) IS NOT NULL THEN 'a dividend takes effect (anchor − D; read for the session: ' || (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ' USD)' ELSE 'a split, or a corrected reading, of the same kind' END || '
' || '$bull ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
' || '$bear ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
USDT = USD ÷ F, F = ' || CASE WHEN x.pf = x.f THEN x.f::text ELSE coalesce(x.pf::text, '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(x.f::text, '–') END || ' USD/USDT (the program''s)' AS text FROM (SELECT s.ts_ms, s.session_id, s.anchor_kind, s.anchor_bull, s.anchor_bear, s.f, lag(s.ts_ms) OVER w AS pts, lag(s.session_id) OVER w AS ps, lag(s.anchor_kind) OVER w AS pk, lag(s.anchor_bull) OVER w AS p_bull, lag(s.anchor_bear) OVER w AS p_bear, lag(s.f) OVER w AS pf FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) - 600000 AND s.ts_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1) AND s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY s.ts_ms)) x WHERE x.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) AND x.pts IS NOT NULL AND (x.anchor_kind, x.anchor_bull, x.anchor_bear) IS DISTINCT FROM (x.pk, x.p_bull, x.p_bear)
